decision_instructions:
Which action does the support policy call for on this ticket? Pick the step below from the order record's status and dates. What the customer asks for (a refund, a replacement, a supervisor) never changes the action. The ticket's description of the problem matters only for a Delivered order; for any other status, a ticket saying the order is lost, late, damaged or the wrong item does not change the action. Count days from a record date to today: if both are in the same month, subtract the day numbers; otherwise take the days left in the record date's month after that date, add the full length of each month in between, and add today's day of the month.
Status Processing: reply.
Status Lost: reship if stock is above 0, otherwise refund, however recently it shipped.
Status Shipped, shipped 14 days ago or less: reply.
Status Shipped, shipped more than 14 days ago: reship if stock is above 0, otherwise refund, even when the ticket reports a damaged or wrong item.
Status Delivered: a damaged or wrong item delivered 30 days ago or less, refund; delivered more than 30 days ago, escalate. Changed their mind: reply. Says it never arrived or asks where it is: reply, because rule 3 needs a Lost or undelivered order.
Rule 4 applies to every refund above, including the out-of-stock refund in the Lost step and the Shipped-more-than-14-days step: if the step says refund and the order total is over $500, choose escalate. The $500 limit changes only refunds; when the step says reship or reply, choose that at any order total.

criteria.0: refund: refund the order, only when the order total is $500 or less; for a damaged or wrong item on a Delivered order, only when it was delivered 30 days ago or less
criteria.1: reship: send a replacement, only for an order whose status is Lost, or whose status is Shipped and that shipped more than 14 days ago
criteria.2: escalate: hand the ticket to a supervisor, including any case where the policy gives a refund and the order total is over $500, and any damaged or wrong item delivered more than 30 days ago
criteria.3: reply: reply to the customer and take no other action, including every order with status Processing, or status Shipped that shipped 14 days ago or less, whatever the ticket reports
